primary.title: Short-duration vs long-duration debt mutual funds: Where should you invest as interest rates are expected to rise now?
primary.summary: Axis Mutual Fund expects another 50–75 bps of rate hikes and favours high-quality corporate bonds with 3–5-year maturities and short-duration debt strategies. It sees scope to add duration selectively as bond yields become more attractive.
